title: "Base Data"
aliases:

---

The Earth-Economy Devstack maintains a single shared, curated data store, **base_data**, that all projects in the stack draw from. Rather than each project bundling (or losing track of) its own copies of common inputs, code references data by a **ref path** (a path relative to the base_data root) and ProjectFlow's `get_path()` resolves it: locally if present, from a shared data root if one is mounted, and otherwise by downloading it from our cloud storage automatically. The full resolution order is defined in [Conventions](../conventions.qmd#get_path-and-ref_path).

The published store, with every dataset, its metadata and its download link, is at **<https://data.teemlabs.org>**.

Two properties make base_data more than a pile of files:

1.  **It is automatically downloadable.** Any project that references data by ref path "just works" on a fresh machine: clone the repo, run it, and `get_path()` fetches what is missing. This is the backbone of our replicability story.
2.  **All rasters are Pyramidal Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs ([POGs](../pogs.qmd)).** Every raster spans the globe on one of a fixed set of nested resolutions with bit-identical geotransforms, which enables downloading a subset of a single raster, exact and very fast zonal statistics, and accurate area-per-cell calculations without ever using projected data.

## What's in it

Data are grouped into **collections**, one per top-level folder. The published ones are listed, with their datasets, at <https://data.teemlabs.org>:

- **`pyramids`**: the canonical `ha_per_cell_<rung>sec.tif` grids the POG system is built on.
- **`lulc`**: land-use and land-cover time series, starting with the ESA CCI / C3S annual maps.

More of the local store (`cartographic`, `gtappy`, `luh2`, `iams`, `crops`, `soil`, `seals`, `global_invest`, `gtap_invest`, `invest_sample_data`) is published as each folder gets its ingestion script. Within these, files follow the EE Spec naming and organization rules in [Conventions](../conventions.qmd), so a ref path is predictable from what the data is.

## How data get in

Each dataset folder carries its own lineage: an ingestion script (`<name>_base_data_ingestion.py`) that turns the raw input in its `raw/` folder into POGs, and the manifest it writes (`<name>_base_data_manifest.csv`) listing each dataset with its metadata. `publish_base_data.py` in this repo combines every manifest, publishes what is new or changed as one release, and rebuilds the pages at data.teemlabs.org. The rules are in [Conventions](../conventions.qmd), under "Base data dataset folders and `raw/`", and the design in the [base data store proposal](../proposal_base_data_store.qmd).

The pages there are built from this folder: `_landing.html` (the landing page), `_folder_page.qmd` (every collection and dataset folder page), `_styles.css`, `_collections.yml` (the collections' titles and descriptions) and `teems_logo.png`. The leading underscores keep this site from rendering them itself. How to edit them is in [Contributing Base Data](../contributing_base_data.qmd#site-pages).

## Contributing

Lab members can contribute their project's input data so their work runs seamlessly for everyone else, by putting it in the `base_data_submissions/` inbox on the NatCapTEEMs shared drive: see [Contributing Base Data](../contributing_base_data.qmd) for the submissions workflow and for how curators promote and publish, and [POGs](../pogs.qmd) for the raster format contributions are cleaned into.

Changes to the store itself are tracked in the [Base Data release notes](../base_data_release_notes.qmd).
